fact: On 16 December 2021 ARPT briefed the press on Decree D/2021/0196 PRG/CNRD/SGG of 9 December 2021 regulating electronic transactions, which makes ARPT the regulator and fee collector for e-commerce and other electronic transactions.
title: CONFERENCE DE PRESSE AUTOUR DU DECRET SUR LA REGLEMENTATION DES TRANSACTIONS ELECTRONIQUES DE GUINEE
